notes.title: Food Truck Shop Simulator Release Postponed - Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone - we’ve got a quick update.
[/p][p]We were aiming to launch Food Truck Shop Simulator in Early Access today, but we underestimated how much time we’d need to wrap things up properly. That’s on us – and we’re truly sorry for the delay.
[/p][p]The good news? We’re almost there! We just need a few extra days to polish the final touches and ensure a smoother launch experience for everyone. The new release date is planned for next week.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXft_TNevUbhUU9oDRCAmL9OkqAB_Hu8q9r_Rdaq-78a_dBupDRT10TGuOQjIDJcIDXT2JafU6utItjXR3W9WHdmgkVze_mo8oljZKV83mwpbDqvHYA7mPeh0drlTYzNkgkj54B_FA?key=f2ALyYQHVTX4EDgRWx5S8A"][/img] Thank you for your patience and support. We can’t wait to get you behind the wheel of your own food truck and start this journey together!
[/p][p]In the meantime, make sure to follow the page to stay updated![/p][p]
[/p]
